name: Lakes Market & Deli
notes: 2 photos, both legible menu boards after digital zoom on the low-res source. Photo 1 is a wide TV-screen shot showing Specialty Pizza and Hot Sandwiches (plus an Original Sandwiches build-your-own board and Extra Topping/catering info, the latter skipped as modifiers). Photo 2 is a closer shot of a different wall board showing Specialty Sandwiches (clear pricing) and a Salads sign whose item names are cut off at the photo edge (not blurred, just out of frame) so Salads were dropped entirely. Greek Pizza's Lg price is genuinely unrecoverable even at extreme zoom (motion blur) and is omitted while its XXL price and description are kept. Extras/Condiments/Bread Choices lists were skipped as modifiers.
